fault: Delta-by-delta convolution called an instance helper as a class function, causing a TypeError. First correction exposed noncanonical plain-Dirac storage.
fix: Bind _attach_deltas to the result; store order-zero rows as (location,magnitude), derivative rows as triples, and sort locations/orders. Existing magnitude filtering and numerical accumulation unchanged.

verification.added_control: Independent mixed derivative orders, location ordering, magnitudes, zero integral and operand immutability.
verification.scope: Frozen project sources, test files, observer and launcher; no exhaustive external runtime closure claim.

limits: This repairs the observed dispatch/storage failure, not all deltafun source parity.
Native per-FUN delta wrapper ownership and finite-delta cumsum remain open.
Native convDeltas uses deltaTol filtering; this patch preserves the prior Python exact-zero accumulator filter and does not qualify threshold-edge parity.
First candidate failed one test (12 passed) after fixing the crash; retained receipt records the storage defect.
